defmodule ImagePipeline.Processor do
  @moduledoc """
  Multi-tenant image processing pipeline with safe templating
  for watermark overlay generation.
  """

  alias ImagePipeline.{TenantConfig, SecurityPolicy, TemplateEngine}

  @allowed_extensions ~w(.png .jpg .jpeg .gif .webp)
  @max_file_size 10_485_760

  def process_image(tenant_id, image_path, opts \\ []) do
    with {:ok, config} <- TenantConfig.fetch(tenant_id),
         {:ok, validated_path} <- validate_path(image_path, tenant_id),
         {:ok, metadata} <- extract_metadata(validated_path),
         {:ok, watermark_text} <- generate_watermark(config, metadata, opts),
         {:ok, output_path} <- apply_watermark(validated_path, watermark_text, config) do
      {:ok, output_path}
    end
  end

  defp validate_path(image_path, tenant_id) do
    base_dir = Path.join(["/data/tenants", tenant_id, "uploads"])
    full_path = Path.expand(image_path, base_dir)

    cond do
      not String.starts_with?(full_path, base_dir) ->
        {:error, :path_traversal}

      not File.exists?(full_path) ->
        {:error, :not_found}

      Path.extname(full_path) not in @allowed_extensions ->
        {:error, :invalid_extension}

      File.stat!(full_path).size > @max_file_size ->
        {:error, :file_too_large}

      true ->
        {:ok, full_path}
    end
  end

  defp extract_metadata(path) do
    case System.cmd("identify", ["-format", "%wx%h %m", path], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
      {output, 0} ->
        [dimensions, format] = String.split(String.trim(output), " ", parts: 2)
        [width, height] = String.split(dimensions, "x") |> Enum.map(&String.to_integer/1)
        {:ok, %{width: width, height: height, format: format, path: path}}

      {error, _} ->
        {:error, {:metadata_extraction_failed, error}}
    end
  end

  defp generate_watermark(config, metadata, opts) do
    template_name = Keyword.get(opts, :watermark_template, config.default_watermark)
    custom_text = Keyword.get(opts, :watermark_text, config.tenant_name)

    template_path = resolve_template_path(config.tenant_id, template_name)

    case File.read(template_path) do
      {:ok, template_content} ->
        rendered = TemplateEngine.render(template_content, %{
          tenant_name: config.tenant_name,
          custom_text: custom_text,
          image_width: metadata.width,
          image_height: metadata.height,
          timestamp: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601()
        })
        {:ok, SecurityPolicy.strip_ssi_directives(rendered)}

      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, {:template_read_failed, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_template_path(tenant_id, template_name) do
    sanitized_name = sanitize_template_name(template_name)
    tenant_path = Path.join(["/data/tenants", tenant_id, "templates", sanitized_name])

    if File.exists?(tenant_path) do
      tenant_path
    else
      Path.join(["/data/shared/templates", sanitized_name])
    end
  end

  defp sanitize_template_name(name) do
    name
    |> String.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]/, "")
    |> then(fn n -> if String.ends_with?(n, ".txt"), do: n, else: n <> ".txt" end)
  end

  defp apply_watermark(image_path, watermark_text, config) do
    output_dir = Path.join(["/data/tenants", config.tenant_id, "processed"])
    File.mkdir_p!(output_dir)
    
    output_path = Path.join(output_dir, "out_" <> Path.basename(image_path))

    # Directly use the safe plaintext watermark - no SSI processing
    safe_text = sanitize_watermark_text(watermark_text)

    composite_result = System.cmd("convert", [
      image_path,
      "(", "-background", "none", "-fill", "white",
      "-font", "Arial", "-pointsize", "24",
      "label:" <> safe_text, ")",
      "-gravity", "southeast", "-composite", output_path
    ], stderr_to_stdout: true)

    case composite_result do
      {_, 0} -> {:ok, output_path}
      {error, _} -> {:error, {:composite_failed, error}}
    end
  end

  defp sanitize_watermark_text(text) do
    text
    |> String.replace(~r/<[^>]+>/, "")
    |> String.replace(~r/<!--.*?-->/, "")
    |> String.trim()
    |> String.slice(0, 200)
  end
end

defmodule ImagePipeline.TemplateEngine do
  @moduledoc "Simple template variable substitution engine"

  def render(template, variables) when is_binary(template) and is_map(variables) do
    Enum.reduce(variables, template, fn {key, value}, acc ->
      safe_value = to_string(value) |> String.replace("<!--", "")
      String.replace(acc, "{{#{key}}}", safe_value)
    end)
  end
end

defmodule ImagePipeline.TenantConfig do
  defstruct [:tenant_id, :tenant_name, :default_watermark, :nginx_port]

  def fetch(tenant_id) do
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{
      tenant_id: tenant_id,
      tenant_name: "Tenant #{tenant_id}",
      default_watermark: "default",
      nginx_port: 8080
    }}
  end
end

defmodule ImagePipeline.SecurityPolicy do
  def strip_ssi_directives(content) do
    content
    |> String.replace(~r/<!--#[^>]*-->/, "[REMOVED]")
    |> String.replace(~r/<!--.*?-->/, "")
  end

  def validate_ssi_content(content) do
    dangerous_patterns = [
      ~r/<!--#exec/i,
      ~r/<!--#include/i,
      ~r/<!--#config/i,
      ~r/<!--#echo/i,
      ~r/<!--#set/i,
      ~r/<!--#if/i
    ]

    if Enum.any?(dangerous_patterns, &Regex.match?(&1, content)) do
      {:error, :dangerous_ssi_directive}
    else
      {:ok, content}
    end
  end
end
